DIAGNOSIS READY: Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome (Chondromalacia Patellae).

I have gathered sufficient clinical information regarding your history, mechanism of injury (pivoting in volleyball), and location of pain to make this diagnosis. Please focus on quad-strengthening exercises and consider a patellar strap for support during your recovery.
